item.title: Navy says USS Gerald R. Ford expected to have extended deployment of 11 months
item.description: The USS Gerald R. Ford is not likely to return home until at least May, about 11 months after the carrier left Naval Station Norfolk, a top Navy official told the Senate Armed Services Committee last week.
